ruleDefinitions.name: Usage Of Web Request Commands And Cmdlets
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of various web request commands with commandline tools and Windows PowerShell cmdlets (including aliases) via CommandLine

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\[System\\\.Net\\\.WebRequest\\]\\:\\:create.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*curl\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Invoke\\-RestMethod.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Invoke\\-WebRequest.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ irm\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*iwr\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Net\\\.WebClient.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Resume\\-BitsTransfer.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Start\\-BitsTransfer.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*wget\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*WinHttp\\\.WinHttpRequest.*"))
